purpose: Check Torch/JAX whole-waveform numerical parity when attachment is evaluated on the actual fine output grid before power-of-two downsampling and coarse-prefix splicing.
protocol: Each backend independently integrates the same physical scalar initial state with 1e-10/1e-9 adaptive tolerances, calibrates NQC on its own fine series, evaluates attachment at 0.015625 M, masks after match plus 150 M, decimates by 32, and splices its NQC-corrected coarse prefix. A common output extent includes both match times.
interpretation: A pass closes selected cross-backend fine-output and splice parity only. It does not establish a source-faithful release model, domain-wide convergence, full parameter gradients, physical NR accuracy, or ROM training.
